title: Unify contact numbers, add submenu pages with SEO & Gtag

requirements.summary: Unify all call and WhatsApp touch-points site-wide to use the single number 919840077591
acceptanceCriteria: Every tel: href across all pages and components equals tel:+919840077591
Every WhatsApp link across all pages and components equals https://wa.me/919840077591
No other phone number appears in any call or WhatsApp link anywhere on the site
Header, Footer, BusinessHighlightsStrip, HotPickSection, ServicesPage, ProductsPage, ContactPage, and WhatsAppQuickMessages all reflect the unified number

requirements.summary: Create a dedicated navigation menu structure with dropdown submenus navigating to unique URLs
acceptanceCriteria: Hovering or clicking a top-level menu item reveals a dropdown with its submenu items
Clicking a submenu item navigates to a unique URL path (e.g. /services/repair) without a full browser reload
The browser address bar updates to the correct URL for each submenu page
Back/forward browser navigation works correctly between submenu pages
Mobile menu collapses/expands and all submenu items are accessible on small screens

file_operations.description: Replace the existing flat navigation with a dropdown menu structure supporting Products (with brand/category sub-items), Services (with service type sub-items like Mobile Repair, CCTV, Accessories, Exchange, EMI), About (with sub-items like Our Story, Why Choose Us), and Contact. Implement hover-based dropdown for desktop and collapsible accordion menu for mobile. Each submenu item must use pushState navigation to unique URLs like /products/apple, /services/repair, /about/story

Register all new submenu routes including product brand pages (/products/apple, /products/samsung, /products/motorola, /products/oneplus, /products/realme, /products/vivo, /products/xiaomi), service pages (/services/repair, /services/cctv, /services/accessories, /services/exchange, /services/emi), and about pages (/about/story, /about/why-choose-us). Ensure the existing SPA page-view tracker is invoked on all route changes to these new paths

requirements.summary: Create individual page components for every submenu route with SEO metadata, structured data, and meaningful content
acceptanceCriteria: Each submenu page has a unique <title> and meta description set via updateSEOMeta()
Each submenu page has a canonical URL meta tag matching its route
Each submenu page injects at least a BreadcrumbList JSON-LD structured data block
Each submenu page contains at least one H1, supporting H2s, and descriptive paragraph content
Each submenu page contains a call or WhatsApp CTA using 919840077591
robots.txt and sitemap.xml are updated to include all new page URLs

requirements.summary: Ensure Google Analytics 4 page_view events fire on every navigation to the new submenu pages and conversion events fire on CTAs
acceptanceCriteria: A GA4 page_view event fires each time the user navigates to any new submenu page URL
The GA4 page_view event includes the correct page_path for each submenu URL
Call CTA clicks on new pages fire the appropriate Google Ads conversion event
WhatsApp CTA clicks on new pages fire the appropriate Google Ads conversion event
No duplicate page_view events fire on a single navigation action

file_operations.description: Verify that the existing SPA page-view tracker correctly intercepts pushState and replaceState calls for all new submenu routes (/products/*, /services/*, /about/*) and sends GA4 page_view events with the correct page_path parameter. Ensure no duplicate events are fired on a single navigation action

Ensure the page-view tracker initialization in App.tsx covers all new submenu routes registered for REQ-2. Verify that initializeSPAPageViews() is called once during app initialization and that the tracker fires page_view events for every route change including to the new product, service, and about submenu pages

Verify that the delegated click tracking system correctly captures call and WhatsApp CTA clicks on all new submenu pages and fires the appropriate GA4 custom events. Ensure the existing data-attribute-based tracking and href pattern matching logic covers CTAs on the new product brand pages, service detail pages, and about pages

Verify that the existing conversion helper functions (trackLead, trackContact, trackWhatsAppClick, trackPhoneCall) are invoked when users interact with call and WhatsApp CTAs on all new submenu pages. Ensure the hardcoded Google Ads account ID remains unchanged and that conversion events are properly attributed to the new page URLs
